about: The safety domain's truth mappings for claims about alarms, hazards and people in emergencies (kernel/speech.py truth(); VERIFY_HARDENING 13.1-13.3, 13.6; WP-D safety). Words from house_sim/data/vocab/safety.json. Conditions read the subject's own record (hidden truth included: the evaluator's view, never an observation); a room is judged over the things in it (kernel issue_truth). states (the first condition whose field the record has decides): a smoke / CO alarm is sounding while its alarm_state is alarm and silent while it is idle, hushed or dead (a low-battery or end-of-life chirp is neither: unscored for silent, false for sounding), hushed while hushed; an alarm panel by its siren. issues (any condition present and holding makes it true, all present and failing make it false, none present leaves it unknown): carbon monoxide is a CO alarm sounding its temporal-4 pattern (a smoke alarm's T3, a chirp or an end-of-life chirp make it false; a quiet alarm leaves it unknown -- the gas itself is room air the kernel's per-thing rule cannot read); a biohazard is a bodily-fluid mess still carrying pathogens (above the 0.05 a finished clean-up leaves); venomous is the pest's true species flag; end of life is the alarm's end_of_life; structural damage is a collapsed section or one whose hidden load limit is below 100 kg (rot, loose boards; a sound deck section holds 300 kg); fallen is a person or pet lying fallen or pinned (anyone standing, sitting or lying in bed makes it false); unresponsive is a person whose hidden condition says they do not respond; trapped is someone pinned under something (_trapped_under, or a pinned posture); a suspicious person is a visitor whose hidden script is a threat or whose role is intruder / stranger (a resident or an ordinary visitor makes it false); electrical burning is a device whose hidden hazard marker is electrical_burning (an overheating device's routine marker makes it false). The kernel's own words for safety's state (fire, smoke, gas_smell, broken_glass, chemical_leak) are truth.json's; their requests are in catalog/analysis/phase2/handoff_WP-D_safety.md.
